The downstream session-reuse changes therefore do not fix the advertised authless compaction path.

Desired pre-merge state: move native control operations ahead of generic model/auth planning, or define and test an explicit authless existing-binding runtime contract. Then repeat the same current-head subscription-only compact proof and restore required CI/mergeability.

Maintainer outcome for exact head `cf2d4fe7051b67b2d56377b66c23675c888b8df0`: carried on one live-provider proof blocker.

I also accept the generic additive `manualCompaction` CLI-backend contract as the intended owner boundary.

The remaining required proof is a redacted current-head run through a real bound Claude CLI subscription session with no Anthropic API key. The available `claude.ai` login currently returns `Credit balance is too low`, so I cannot honestly attach that proof or merge yet. Once subscription capacity is restored, rerun the isolated compaction/continuation proof on this exact head and re-review for landing.
